description: Writes, audits and builds landing and sales pages that sell by making the product's value obvious: grounded in real facts and customer language, structured by awareness level, rendered on desktop and mobile, linted, and scored with a value-perception rubric.

tools.name: capture_page
tools.description: Renders a page with Playwright and records what is visible in the first screen on desktop and mobile.

tools.name: extract_page
tools.description: Extracts a page's message hierarchy: hero, sections, CTAs, forms, prices, quotes and meta.

tools.name: copy_lint
tools.description: Flags hype, unproven claims, fake urgency, generic CTAs and placeholders; checks numbers against a facts file.

tools.name: value_score
tools.description: Turns per-lever scores with evidence into the weighted value-perception score, applying caps.
